tool_input.description: Probe compile to verify presence of referenced CSV types and enum constants

result:
The test class compiles successfully with `./compile.sh`.

**Summary:** Created `tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `CSVFormat`'s documented contract: all predefined formats (`DEFAULT`, `EXCEL`, `RFC4180`, `TDF`, `MYSQL`, `ORACLE`, `POSTGRESQL_CSV/TEXT`, `MONGODB_CSV/TSV`, `INFORMIX_UNLOAD(_CSV)`), the `Predefined` enum, `newFormat`/`valueOf`/`copy`/`clone`/`equals`/`hashCode`, the `Builder` (fluent setters, validation of line-break characters, header/array defensive copying, enum-based headers), parsing/printing behavior (`format`, `print`, `println`, `printRecord`, `parse`, file/path printing), and the large set of deprecated `with*` delegating methods — including boundary cases (line-break delimiters/quotes/escapes, invalid record separators, malformed quoted input, null/empty headers).
